charges.label: Weight component (INR 6.00 per kg of billed weight)
charges.quote: a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight

charges.label: Distance component (INR 2.00 per km of booked lane distance)
charges.quote: a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance

charges.label: Cold chain premium (20% of freight charge = weight + distance components)
charges.quote: carry a premium of 20% on the freight charge (the sum of the weight and distance components)

document_rules.rule: Each invoice line's c-note must correspond to a Customer booking; lines that cannot be matched are not payable until reconciled.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices, referencing the original c-note number and the invoice corrected.
A credit note must cover the full corrected amount.
Carrier invoices as trips are pooled, typically fortnightly; payment due 21 days from invoice date (payment term, not a dispute window).

notes: Freight = 6.00/kg x billed weight + 2.00/km x distance (§1), no minimum stated. Cold chain premium 20% of weight+distance (§3). Only standard service offered (§2). No clause makes unlisted charges non-payable, so closed_list is false; the contract lists no fragile/residential charges, so none are encoded. No volume discount.
